messages:
michelle_marketing: Quick sync on SolarFlux customer story. We have signed release and a two-minute interview clip. Need final quote wording + legal ok by Wed COB to hit next-week launch.

sam_content: I'll draft the case study and 3 headline variations tonight. Prefer to avoid any hard ARR or contract length mentions per legal.

kai_cs: Customer approved a short quote but asked to remove references to specific cloud vendors. Attribution: 'M. Chen, Head of ML'. Signed PDF attached.

eli_pm: Performance highlights: steady-state throughput nearly 3x, p95 latency down from ~430ms to ~160ms. I'll upload the sanitized benchmark CSV to the PR.

zoe_design: I'll create hero art + a small stat card. Which logo? Customer gave horizontal and square; they prefer horizontal.

legal_bot: Confirmed: redact hostnames and contract numbers. Keep quote verbatim as in signed PDF. Distribution limited to NA/EU only per customer request.

sam_content: Draft headlines: 1) "SolarFlux scales inference predictably with Redwood" 2) "SolarFlux achieves nearly 3x throughput on Redwood" 3) "How SolarFlux cut p95 latency by two-thirds" Any preferences?

michelle_marketing: Use 1 for the blog, 2 for paid social (with "nearly 3x" wording the customer approved), 3 as an experiment. Make sure the quote language matches the signed PDF exactly.

ops_bot: Reminder: put sanitized assets under s3://redwood-marketing/solarflux/sanitized/2026-03-25/ and run the PR scanner.

kai_cs: Customer replied: approved the final copy and timing. They asked publish not before Fri 9am PT. Signed release uploaded.

zoe_design: Uploaded assets to design/marketing/solarflux-package-v1.zip. Left space for the exact pull quote.

michelle_marketing: Great  I'll open the PR and tag reviewers. Target internal review by Thu 3pm PT, publish Fri 9am PT. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
